run_fastcsp_workflow: run the FastCSP crystal structure prediction workflow with a YAML config and selected stages
run_fastcsp_generate: run the generate stage to create crystal structures using Genarris from a molecules file
run_fastcsp_relax: run the relax stage to perform ML-based structure relaxation using UMA on deduplicated structures
run_fastcsp_filter: run the filter stage to energy-filter and deduplicate ML-relaxed structures with cutoff thresholds
run_fastcsp_evaluate: run the evaluate stage to compare predicted structures against experimental data using pymatgen
